name: How-to books
description: Every English book on Project Gutenberg's "How To ..." bookshelf that PG marks public domain, split into chapter documents, plus original task-focused how-to guides that cite those chapters. Covers cooking, gardening, crafts, building, animals, outdoor skills, household management, and more. Historical practices are reproduced as written; guides add modern safety notes.
